# ProteinLens

> AI-powered macro nutrition tracker. Snap a photo of your meal and get instant protein, carbs, fat & calorie breakdowns — no manual logging, no barcode scanning.

ProteinLens uses computer vision to analyze food photos and estimate macronutrient content in seconds. Built for people who want to track their nutrition without the friction of traditional food logging apps.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.proteinlens.com/): AI meal scanning — upload a photo, get instant macro breakdowns
- [Pricing](https://www.proteinlens.com/pricing): Free tier (3 scans/day) and Pro plans (monthly €9.99, annual €79)
- [How It Works](https://www.proteinlens.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step explanation of the AI food scanning process
- [Features](https://www.proteinlens.com/features): Full feature list — AI scanning, macro tracking, meal history, sharing
- [About](https://www.proteinlens.com/about): Team and mission
- [Methodology](https://www.proteinlens.com/methodology): How ProteinLens estimates macros from photos — AI model details and accuracy

## Free Tools

- [Protein Calculator](https://www.proteinlens.com/protein-calculator): Calculate daily protein needs by weight, activity & goals — reference tables, 8 FAQs, research citations
- [Calorie Calculator](https://www.proteinlens.com/calorie-calculator): Daily calorie needs for weight loss, maintenance or muscle gain — Mifflin-St Jeor, reference tables, 8 FAQs
- [TDEE Calculator](https://www.proteinlens.com/tdee-calculator): Total Daily Energy Expenditure — BMR/NEAT/TEF/EAT breakdown, activity tables, 8 FAQs
- [Macro Calculator](https://www.proteinlens.com/macro-calculator): Protein/carbs/fat split calculator — 6 diet comparisons (IIFYM, keto, low carb, high protein, Zone, Mediterranean), 8 FAQs
